title: About Us
description: The story of Jauhar Urban Farming, a student-led fertigation farm at IIUM Gombak founded in 2021, growing food and community on campus land.
heading: Growing food, growing people.
lead: Rooted in the heart of IIUM Gombak, Jauhar Urban Farming is more than an agricultural initiative. It is a commitment to sustainable practices, student empowerment, and a closer relationship between campus and nature.
imageAlt: Two volunteers bagging freshly harvested cucumbers beside the trellis rows
